sections.title: Regional IRPEF surcharge 2026 (Marche)

source.title: MEF Dipartimento delle Finanze: Addizionale regionale all'IRPEF, aliquote applicabili 2026, REGIONE MARCHE (published 2026-01-22)

sections.basis: IRPEF taxable income, per year (bands as published by MEF; see the special rules)
sections.note: Rates apply to each band of income.

rows.label: Special rules (disposizioni particolari)
rows.value: 1.23% for taxpayers with income up to €50,000 and one or more dependent children with a disability (Law 104/1992).
